Dear Ms. Okonkwo,

The delivery has been delayed by two weeks due to a third-party API outage that affected our integration testing window. While we cannot control external provider stability, we should have communicated the risk sooner.

Thank you for your patience and partnership as we work to deliver a stable solution.

Elena Vasquez
Project Lead
